notes.title: 'Live Empire 2' has released as Early Access
notes.content:
'[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1597280/2/]Live Empire 2[/url]', a simulated nurturing game, has now released as Early Access.

See the discussion board for the Adult Only DLC of the game.

notes.title: Important Notice
notes.content:
Soon, a new version of the game will be released. Based on feedback we recieved, we will make structural adjustments to the entire gameplay experience, speed up the process of experiencing the story, remove duplicate level branches, and adjust all experience gains so that everyone can experience the game more smoothly.
After this version is released, we will continue to add the story for all languages.
"Joan of Arc" will be reworked in the near future, remaking the underlying layer to make the game smoother, and focus on improving the art.
